SHARED-F-1-S174.title: Anthropic Tool Use Block Parsing and Enforcement
SHARED-F-1-S174.description: Implement parsing of Anthropic tool_use blocks within the tool router, ensuring each requested tool call is validated against the allowlist and routed only if compliant.

SHARED-F-1-S175.title: Domain Service Invocation via Tool Router
SHARED-F-1-S175.description: Connect allowlisted tool calls to their corresponding domain services (provider search, clinical trials, consent, etc.), ensuring correct parameter passing and response handling.

SHARED-F-1-S176.title: Tool Routing Error Handling and Safe Fallbacks
SHARED-F-1-S176.description: Implement structured error handling for invalid tool calls, schema validation failures, and disallowed tools, returning safe fallback responses without breaking the chat flow.

SHARED-F-1-S177.title: Tool Routing Debug Logging and Audit Trail
SHARED-F-1-S177.description: Integrate debug logging to capture tool routing decisions, validation outcomes, and execution traces for observability and QA validation.
